title: Thumbily
description: A modpack that helps Minecraft creators make better thumbnails in a variety of styles.
body:
# 🎬 Thumbily - The Content Creator's Thumbnail Modpack

Thumbily is a modpack designed to help content creators produce high-quality thumbnails in Minecraft. It combines performance mods, multiple shader packs, and creative tools to let you work efficiently without worrying about frame drops.

## ✨ What's Included

### ⚡ Performance & Rendering
* **Sodium** - Fast rendering engine
* **Iris Shaders** - High-quality shader support
* **Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (C2ME)** - Optimized chunk loading
* **StutterFix** - Removes frame stuttering
* **Entity View Distance** - Fine-tune entity rendering distance

### 🎨 Visual Enhancements
* **Fresh Animations** - Smooth player animations
* **Bobby** - Extended render distance for wider shots
* **Sodium Extra** - Additional visual tweaks
* **Screenshot to Clipboard** - Quick screenshot saving

### 🌅 Shader Packs
* **BSL Shaders** - Balanced visuals and performance
* **Complementary Shaders (Reimagined & Unbound)** - Popular community shaders
* **Solas Shader** - High-quality visuals
* **DMS - Depth Map Shaders** - Unique depth effects
* **Fullbright UB** - Clean, bright visuals

### 🎥 Content Tools
* **ReplayMod** - Capture cinematic angles and replays
* **NewNPCs** - Add NPCs to thumbnails
* **Mod Menu** - Easy mod configuration
* **Fzzy Config** - Advanced configuration options

## 🎛️ Optional Enhancements

**3D Skin Layers** can be installed separately if you want to add depth to player skins. It works with all included shaders.

## 🎯 Why Use Thumbily?

* ⚡ **Performance** - Smooth framerates even with shaders enabled
* 🎨 **Flexibility** - Multiple shader options for different looks
* 🎬 **Creator Tools** - ReplayMod and other tools built in
* ⚙️ **Customization** - Easy to adjust settings to your needs

## ℹ️ Notes

* **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1
* **Loader:** Fabric
* All shaders are optional—disable if needed for better performance
* If your launcher doesn't support Modrinth, you can get a zip file including mods and other items by searching for `.mrpack to zip converter` on Google, opening any website, and uploading the `.mrpack` there. I will recommend using the fabulously-optimized website.
